250 Housing Units with Commercial Rental and Concierge Services
MIXED-USE RESIDENTIAL
A residential development comprising 250 rent-to-own housing units at the Bouraada site in Reghaia, delivered with integrated ground-floor commercial premises and dedicated concierge facilities.
The master plan organises seven R+9 blocks—each consisting of a ground floor plus 9 upper floors—to balance high-density residential accommodation with active street-level commercial frontage.

The residential programme provides 250 rent-to-own apartments distributed across seven blocks, featuring a standardised floor plate of four units per level in a balanced F3 and F4 configuration. The ground-floor levels are structurally configured to support commercial rental units and dedicated concierge offices, enhancing the active street-level frontage.

The scope of execution encompasses all-trades delivery (TCE), including structural completion, facade articulation, internal secondary works, technical building services, and the installation of roads and utility networks (VRD) to integrate the development with the surrounding municipal infrastructure.
This seven-block residential development was executed under a comprehensive all-trades contract, managing structural works, facade finishes, internal services, and site-wide utility connections.

What is the scope of the 250 Housing Units project in Reghaia?
The project comprises the construction of 250 rent-to-own residential apartments across seven R+9 blocks, complete with ground-floor commercial premises and dedicated concierge spaces.
What are the architectural and structural specifications of the blocks?
The programme delivers 250 rent-to-own homes, with four units per floor and a clear F3/F4 mix supported by commercial premises and concierge spaces.
Which construction works were executed on this site?

The contract was executed as an all-trades package (TCE), covering structural works, facade articulation, internal secondary works, technical building services, and site-wide roads and utility networks (VRD).
How is the ground floor of the development utilised?
Reghaia organises seven R+9 blocks around practical family housing, local services and concierge spaces that make the residence easier to live in.
